The '''Tusken Relic Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] complex on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was inhabited by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. The cave was located in the [[Tusken March/Legends|Tusken March]] region of Tatooine, near [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]]. The cave was where a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe (Tusken King)|tribe of Tusken Raiders]] kept their most sacred relics. These relics included a [[Ghastly baton|ghastly]] [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]] baton, a [[chieftain's skull]], and a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] [[Krayt head|head]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]&mdash;a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]&mdash;, the relics were stolen from the cave by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] hired by the scholar [[Srimaur]]. This provoked the Tuskens to [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|attack]] the city of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] in retribution.<ref name="SWG:TR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tusken Relic Cave appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Tusken Relic Cave was added to the game on [[November 1]], [[2007]] as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes]]" game update.<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref> It was part of the quest known as "[[W:c:swg:Tusken Relics|Tusken Relics]]" that the player was required to complete before they could access the "[[W:c:swg:Tusken Army|Tusken Army]]" heroic encounter, which depicted an attack on Mos Espa by the aforementioned Tusken army. The player had to reach the combat level of 70 before they could acquire the quest, though it was recommended to be level ninety, the level cap, before attempting it alone.<ref name="SWG:TR" />
